Interface IChannelLayout

Namespace
FFmpeg.Audio
Assembly
FFmpeg.dll

Defines an interface for working with channel layouts in audio processing.

public interface IChannelLayout : IEquatable<IChannelLayout>
Inherited Members
IEquatable<IChannelLayout>.Equals(IChannelLayout)

Remarks

Implementations of this interface should provide the ability to access channel layout properties, validate the layout, and copy or initialize the layout as needed.
